102: An unprecedented series of violent tornadoes is sweeping across Oklahoma. All The Uproarious Fun Of the Smash Broadway Play!

The battle for the lawn is on.

Where do you hide when the dark is alive?

The girls and guys who make the office such a wonderful place to love in!

RECKLESS with WOMEN...He pursued them ..."petted" them...promised them nothing and got away with everything!

The fall of an empire will be the rise of another.

Her passion was cooking, her obsession was deadly

You've never seen a honeymoon like this

The best secrets are the hardest to find.

But his last performance plunges him deep into a treacherous rabbit hole. Sharafat Karim Ayna / Nizam Sayeed Chowdhury

His shockingly violent plan will shake the very foundations of society by painting the streets red with blood.

With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

From the shadows of betrayal shall rise a king.

28006: To escape the outback, a young Afghan cameleer falls in with a mysterious bushman on the run with stolen Crown gold.
There is no Grace of God here. Just the land, and all its spoils.

28518: The life story of Italian violinist and composer, Niccolò Paganini, who rose to fame as a virtuoso in the early 19th Century.
Fame is desire, love is a curse.

How to rob a bank... and get away with it?

30822: Beauty Blogger Alexa Landry only had one fear, plastic surgery. She ultimately had to face this fear when she was kidnapped with her friends by Dr. Cunningham. A deranged plastic surgeon who is obsessed with beautifying his victims.

32870: Roy, a village boy who's a failure at studies, joins Christy's tuition. They become good friends, but later when Christy gets a job abroad, Roy's life changes
33126: Pulled into the Mexican Revolution by his own greed, Texas gunrunner and pilot Lee Arnold joins bandit-turned-patriot Pancho Villa and his band of dedicated men in a march across Mexico battling the Colorados and stealing women's hearts as they go. Villa rages! Villa lusts! Villa kills! VILLA RIDES!
33382: A serial killer is going around killing Iran's most beloved filmmakers. Hasan, a blacklisted filmmaker himself, is depressed and wonders: why isn't he being targeted?
33638: A young woman dutifully marries an older millionaire and then falls in love with a handsome nobleman-- who'd previously saved her life-- on her unhappy honeymoon.
34406: Midnight, New Year’s Eve: when all the hopes of new beginnings come to life – except for Lindsey and Jeff Pittman, whose strained marriage faces the ultimate test after they cover up a terrible crime and find themselves entangled in a Hitchcockian web of deceit and madness.
Killing is easy. Getting away with it is murder.
34662: Om, a special forces para commando officer, loses his memory while fighting enemies. After recovering from amnesia, Om is on a mission to save the nation from terrorists. As he fights the challenges the mission presents, he learns a shocking truth about his life.
34918: Jefferson is a lovable ski-bum temp worker whose singular joy comes from an annual excursion to the slopes with fellow vagabond/best friend, Curtis. 35174: A chronicle of a supermarket security guard's obsession with a late-shift janitor.
35430: Siddharth strives to help flood victims and saves the relief material from falling into the wrong hands. This sets off a war between him and a corrupt politician, which leads to many twists and turns.
35686: Russell has been expelled from several schools for lewd, crude and nude conduct. Busterburger University is his last chance at education and satisfying his disappointed parents.
35942: A world-class spy falls for an unlikely woman and must work out how to build a relationship with a normal person while others around him try and destroy both the relationship and much more.
36198: Blind swordsman/masseuse Zatoichi befriends a young woman returning home with her baby. 36454: West Texas, in the 1960's. A tale of two 12-year-olds who embark on an adventure to find new parents in order to escape their unhappy and emotionally unsatisfying family life.
You're never too young to have a plan
36710: In his quest to become the world's greatest air-drummer, a small-town dreamer must overcome obstacles and ridicule to save the day.
March to the beat of your own drum. Even if you don't have one.
36966: Having been one of the most eminent scholars of the recent past, Bediuzzaman Said Nursi's Barla life.
37222: While Charlie is distracted with the birth of his first grandchild, son Jimmy impersonates his father in order to investigate a murder aboard a freighter in the harbor.
37478: The members of a sci-fi club accidentally spill Coke on the remote controller of an air-conditioner during summer and suddenly a time machine appears in their sweating bath-like clubroom.
37734: Their crimes earned them the nickname Bitcoin Bonnie and Clyde — and the story only gets weirder in this documentary about the most lucrative heist ever.
37990: A young woman is held captive in an underground medical facility where selected individuals are perpetually mutilated and then healed using an experimental miracle drug: a panacea.
38246: Somewhere in Europe, mid-20th century. Albert is employed to look after Mia, a girl with teeth of ice. Mia never leaves their apartment, where the shutters are always closed. 38502: Scout William F. Cody marries a U.S. senator's daughter, fights the Cheyenne and leads a Wild West show.
His adventure made him a hero.His showmanship made him a legend.
38758: Aspiring college cheerleader, Cassie Stratford consumes an experimental drug that grants her beauty and enough athletic ability to make the cheer squad. The drug has an unforeseen side effect — Cassie starts to grow and grow and grow!
Look at the size of those pom poms!
39014: Three friends discover that they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hope, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.
39526: Casey, a country lad running from a small-town scandal, finds himself down and out in big city Sydney. When he meets city lad Tib both men find something they have been missing but neither of them knows quite how to negotiate it.
39782: When a technical error annuls the union of all married couples in Egypt, a journalist sets out to investigate rising marital issues— including his own.
40038: College freshman Si-ying gets a part-time job at “Cafe. Waiting. Love” coffee shop, where she befriends Abusi, a tomboyish barista who can make any coffee the customers request, the beautiful and mysterious cafe owner, and Zeyu, the boy who always sits in the same spot in the cafe who seems to be very popular with girls and on whom Si-ying develops an instant crush.
40294: In his 10th year at college, Eun-sik is part of a nearly ideal campus couple with swimming champ Kyung-ah. While their three-year relationship is solid, Eun-sik struggles to get to the next level with Kyung-ah; despite the help and support of his friends, he can't manage to get her into bed.
40550: Struggling movie producer To Wai-chen needs money for child support, so he reluctantly agrees to film a softcore remake of a Chinese classic.
40806: A young man struggles to pay off his father's debts and decides to visit his family's abandoned bungalow. However, he soon realises that it is haunted by a vengeful ghost.
41062: Under provincial Italian law at the time, once a roof is erected, the occupants cannot be evicted from a building. This film follows the efforts of a family to erect the roof on a house overnight so that a newlywed couple can have their own home.

Once the murder was solved, the real mystery began…
41574: Anne Shirley, an orphan, is fostered by farmer Matthew Cuthbert and his sister Marilla, who were expecting a boy to be sent them to help with their farm work. They accept Anne, who quickly endears herself to them and to the local villagers.
A PICTURE MADE FOR THE MILLIONS WHO LOVED "LITTLE WOMEN"

42086: Ivan is a very lonely 8 year boy who is bullied almost every day in school. Even his father taunts him because Ivan litteraly is a weakling (That should explain the title Rubber Tarzan). Once again, internationally acclaimed Bille August exhibits the weaknesses of human beings in comparison to the ruthless nature. 42598: A barber working in Istanbul longs to be ‘both here and far, far away’. One day, he takes the day off and disappears abruptly without warning anyone. He then settles in a far-flung village. Some mysterious events start happening in the village as people disappear one by one.

43878: Senada is 31 and she lives in Poljice neighborhood in Lukavac municipality with her partner and two daughters. She is pregnant with her third child for approximately five months. 44134: During the American Civil War, five northern POWs make the decision to escape the war by hijacking a hot air balloon. Drifting through the night, they wake to find themselves marooned on a desert island, but they aren't alone.

44646: Juzo Murasaki is a young man traumatized by his experience of bullying at school. He returns to his hometown and takes a job on a building site with his old nemesis Toru Akai. What if your personality began to crumble… who would you become?

45158: A runaway bride promises her dying widowed friend that she will assume her identity and look after her infant child.
45414: Abandoned by her lover, a woman becomes the main "hostess" in a decadent nightclub, but tries to put her past behind her on a steamer to Mandalay.
THE STORY OF A WOMAN WHO SWORE TO LIVE HER FUTURE SO MADLY SHE WOULD FORGET THE MADNESS OF HER PAST!
Tanya Borodoff aka Spot White / Marjorie Lang
45670: Van Heflin stars as the head of a city crime lab who tries to solve the murder of the town mayor by scientifically analyzing evidence.
Crime under the microscope. Introducing Police chemist Gordon McKay.
45926: 24 hours in the life of a mother, caught in the  relentlessness of daily life, between her work, her home and her children.

The story of a lusty, fighting young adventurer who exchanged his sword for a cross
46438: Jane appears to be ideal: attractive, intelligent, unruffled by her employer's abrupt eccentricities. But, gradually, we come aware that Jane has another agenda. She has a secret he can’t see.
46694: A former communist militant and a "live and let live" man form an unlikely friendship on a park bench, sharing their life stories with humor and heart.
Sometimes it’s good to talk to strangers.
46950: She's a divorce lawyer, single mother and perpetually at war against men, he is a couple's therapist, single and not looking, they meet and collide in a bourgeois and romantic Rome...
47206: With the 10-year high school reunion around the corner, Xander and his squad embark on a journey to become the dopest versions of themselves in time to flex on all of their old classmates.
47462: The story is one of an architect that has lost his inspiration and goes looking for those motivations that pushed him as a youngster to take up the profession. The film’s central story ends up being the love story that develops between architecture, artistic inspiration and feelings.
47718: A conservative Muslim girl falls in love with an agnostic journalist.
47974: Balu, on a visit to his friend's hometown, falls for the latter's sister, Hema. When he learns that this area is ruled by a local goon, Kaasi, Balu teaches him a lesson. Now, Kaasi is seeking revenge.

He tries to force her to marry him but she is rescued by her love in an exciting battle on the beach.
A Forbidden Love That Threatened Two Kingdoms!

With a six-year-old boy, they started playing the soldier game in order to preserve his childhood, and he, in order to comply with this honorary title, became a real defender of the Motherland.

48998: A college professor who believes there's no place for jealousy in modern marriage, John Hathaway (Don Ameche) moves with his wife, Julie (Rosalind Russell), to New York where he plans to publish a book on the subject. If your sweetheart isn't jealous, it's not L-O-V-E!

Give him 12 weeks. He'll give you a Few Good Men.

Perfect Car. Perfect Girl. Perfect Murder... Almost.
